neighbours.label: a business giving a share of its sales or matching funds to a cause ('gives 1% of sales to', 'donates $1 from every box', 'match funds')
fire: The shoe brand gives 5% of profits to children's hospitals.
For each bag sold, the bakery donates fifty cents to a food bank.
A local dealer has pledged to match donations up to $2000.
The soap maker gives one bar to a shelter for every 5 it sells.
A percentage of the ticket sales will go to cancer research.
The coffee chain donates $1 from each bag to rainforest groups.
Our company will match every dollar raised by the staff.
This brewery gives a tenth of its income to river cleanup.
quiet: The shoe brand sells 5% more sneakers to children's stores.
For each bag sold, the bakery prints a coupon for the next visit.
A local dealer has decided to close on Mondays after 2000.
The soap maker ships one crate to a shop for every order.
A number of the ticket holders will go to the second show.
The coffee chain buys beans from each farm in rainforest areas.
Our company will check every invoice sent by the staff.
This brewery uses a tenth of its barley in winter ale.

short: a business giving sales to a cause
notes: Card: '0' x4, ' of' x3, ' to' x2, ' donated' x2, ' Registered' x2, ' match', 'IC' of FDIC. Probe: ' of' after 'gives 1%' 0.727; ' to' after 'every box sold' 0.636; ' every' 0.610; ' match' 0.482; the same firms selling or shipping 0.012-0.056. 'polled 2,000 Canadians' read 0.375 and the ' Registered' and FDIC peaks are not covered.
